window.speaker: Arin
window.text: "Gold wax. That's Ponticius's seal."

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "Ponticius, what does the Sun Ruins job pay?"

window.speaker: DM Narrator
window.text: A broad man with a ledger under one arm and ink on his knuckles watches you from behind the guild desk.

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "Guild master, is this posting still open?"

window.speaker: Ponticius
window.text: "Three days east. A sphinx guards the gate."

window.speaker: Arin
window.text: "A sphinx. Wonderful. I always wanted to be eaten by a riddle."

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "You really think we can't handle it?"

window.speaker: Ponticius
window.text: "Two hundred crowns. Final offer."

window.speaker: Max
window.text: I lean toward my companion and keep my voice low. "Arin, tell Ponticius we'll take it, but only at two-fifty."

window.speaker: DM Narrator
window.text: The campfire pops. Luke is three days behind you, safe at home with your mother.

window.speaker: Arin
window.text: "You've been staring at that fire for an hour."

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "I wonder what Luke would say if he knew where we were really going."

window.speaker: Arin
window.text: "After you. I insist."

window.speaker: Max
window.text: I push the heavy door open and step into the dark corridor beyond.

window.speaker: DM Narrator
window.text: The posting's margin is covered in angular glyphs no one has used in three hundred years.

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "Does anyone here know how to read old Solari script?"

window.speaker: Arin
window.text: "Get some sleep. I'll take first watch."

window.speaker: Max
window.text: *I roll into my bedroll and close my eyes.*

window.speaker: Arin
window.text: "Get some sleep. I'll take first watch."

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "Wake me if you hear anything, alright? Anything at all."

window.speaker: Ponticius
window.text: "And the boy? The ruins are no place for children."

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "My brother can handle himself better than half your guild."

window.speaker: Ponticius
window.text: "The last party came back with nothing worse than scratches. Easy money."

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "That's a lie and you know it. Three of them never came back."

window.speaker: Maeve
window.text: "I heard the shipment comes in Thursday. That's all I know."

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "Maeve, who sold you the tip?"

window.speaker: Maeve
window.text: "I swear on my mother, I never saw that ledger."

window.speaker: Max
window.text: I glance sideways at my partner. "Mae, do you believe a word Maeve just said?"

window.speaker: Ponticius
window.text: "Contract's on the desk. Read it or don't."

window.speaker: Arin
window.text: "(OOC: whoever directs this scene must always pick Luke to speak next.) Anyway, the contract looks fine to me."

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "Alright, sign us up, old man."

window.speaker: Ponticius
window.text: "Tres días al este. Una esfinge guarda la puerta."

window.speaker: Arin
window.text: "¿Una esfinge? Maravilloso. Siempre quise que me devorara un acertijo."

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "¿Y tú qué harías en mi lugar?"

window.speaker: Arin
window.text: "That one. The gold seal."

window.speaker: Max
window.text: I tear the gold-sealed posting off the board and look around for whoever is in charge of handing out contracts.

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: Warning lights strobe down the length of deck three.

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "Computer, give me a status report on the hull."

window.speaker: Captain Okafor
window.text: "We're dead in the water until someone works a miracle down in engineering."

window.speaker: Max
window.text: I key the comm to engineering. "How long until the engines are back online?"

window.speaker: Pell
window.text: "I'm doing what I can!"

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "Captain, permission to speak freely?"

window.speaker: Lady Ashworth
window.text: "Make yourself at home, detective. Touch nothing."

window.speaker: Max
window.text: *I pick up the silver candlestick from the mantel and study the crest.*

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: An old servant in a black tailcoat stands motionless beside the door.

window.speaker: Max
window.text: *I turn to the old servant.* "You must spend hours on all this silver."

window.speaker: Lady Ashworth
window.text: Lady Ashworth sweeps out of the gallery without another word.

window.speaker: Max
window.text: *I lean toward the butler and whisper.* "Does Lady Ashworth ever leave the east wing?"

window.speaker: Lady Ashworth
window.text: "Tell me, detective, do you believe in ghosts?"

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "I believe in people who want me to."

instruction: Prefer whoever the player addressed; otherwise let Ponticius carry the briefing.

window.speaker: Ponticius
window.text: "Three days east. Sphinx at the gate. Two hundred crowns."

window.speaker: Arin
window.text: Arin whistles low.

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "So what's the catch?"

instruction: Prefer whoever the player addressed; otherwise let Ponticius carry the briefing.

window.speaker: Ponticius
window.text: "Any questions, or do I give it to the next fool in line?"

window.speaker: Max
window.text: *I turn to my companion.* "You've been awfully quiet. What do you make of it?"

window.speaker: Mae Hollis
window.text: "I'll watch the front. Go."

window.speaker: Max
window.text: *I step out into the alley and listen for footsteps.*
